title: Repayment of Claim Money After Stolen Property Is Recovered — Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
When stolen property on a paid claim under a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan is recovered, the adjuster records a further assessment of the property still missing, and the tenant may settle the recovery by repaying the claim money the recovered property no longer supports.

## When the repayment is fixed

The recovery repayment on a claim is fixed only after every claim filed under the same police report number on the tenant's other protected units carries a claim decision.

The recovery repayment is not fixed until every protection fee charged a second time for the same billing period on the plan carries a billing-error credit on the fee ledger.

## What the repayment does on the records

The repayment is recorded on the claim as a void of the claim payment it reverses, with the void reason stolen property recovered and the date it is taken, and the net claim money shown as paid on the tenant's protection plan falls by the amount repaid.

## Function: `repay_recovered_claim_money_180976c0`

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own act: the repayment comes from the tenant's own funds. The agent unlocks `repay_recovered_claim_money_180976c0` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claim_id` | the protection claim number of the claim whose recovered property is being repaid, as shown in the claim lookup the agent reads out to the tenant | identifier text |
| `reference_event_id` | the reference number of the claim payment event this repayment reverses, as shown in the claim's handling history the agent reads out to the tenant | identifier text |
| `amount` | the repayment the tenant pays, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

**Return.** A receipt with `claim_event_id` (the reference number of the repayment entry), `claim_id` (the claim repaid), `reference_event_id` (the claim payment reversed), `amount` (the amount repaid, USD, 2 decimal places), `void_reason` (always `stolen_property_recovered`), `event_date` (the date recorded, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (`repayment_recorded` when the repayment has been taken).

## Illustration (hypothetical)

The tenant runs the function with the claim number, the reference number of the claim payment being reversed and an `amount` of 640.00; the receipt shows `void_reason` `stolen_property_recovered`, `amount` 640.00 and `status` `repayment_recorded`, and the plan's claims-paid total is 640.00 lower.
